summary: New-style PowerShell modules use the module_replacer framework, which embeds a PowerShell library before sending them to the target.
questions: How are PowerShell modules assembled before being sent to Windows?

answer_card.title: PowerShell module assembly
answer_card.answer_md: PowerShell modules use the **module_replacer** framework, which embeds a library of PowerShell code into the module before sending it to the managed node.
